artifacts.name: LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN
artifacts.description: Full LLD for NFR-PERF-001: Puppeteer-based automated performance test harness enforcing ≥60 FPS (p95 frame time <16.7ms) with 500 bricks. Covers performanceMonitor utility, p95 algorithm, CI integration, SwiftShader WebGL config, and test case mapping.

summary.work_completed: Low-Level Design for NFR-PERF-001 authored and merged via PR #51. LLD specifies a Puppeteer-based automated performance test harness that enforces ≥60 FPS (p95 frame time <16.7ms) with 500 bricks on mid-range hardware. Design covers performanceMonitor.ts utility, three brick-count scenarios (100/250/500), p95 calculation with 60-frame warmup discard, SwiftShader WebGL for CI, and build-failing CI integration.
key_findings: LLD already merged to main via PR #51 (merged 2026-04-11T06:56:16Z) — idempotent re-trigger
performanceMonitor.ts attaches to window only in NODE_ENV !== 'production' (zero production bundle impact)
SwiftShader WebGL (--use-gl=swiftshader) enables Three.js rendering in headless CI without GPU
60-frame warmup discard eliminates Three.js scene initialization overhead from p95 measurement
Separate jest.performance.config.ts with 30s timeout isolates perf tests from unit/integration suite

human_review_required.item: 30 FPS floor as warning vs. hard assertion
human_review_required.reason: Issue specifies minimum frame time never below 33.3ms (30 FPS floor) — unclear if this should be a hard CI failure or advisory warning
CI runners use software rendering; threshold may need adjustment if SwiftShader cannot sustain 60 FPS
